scope: Rigid normal contact on fixed plane, fixed-base Panda; simulation only
controller: ordinary PID + gravity compensation + gated admittance + differential IK
limitations: Braking uses nominal plane height, not camera or distance sensing
Rigid force peaks remain sensitive to geometry and solver
A 100Hz mean-force band does not guarantee an instantaneous 1kHz band
Height/friction validation is finite and does not establish industrial robustness
